name: White wing Leads to the Truth
source:
The protagonist meets a mysterious girl who judges his fate... his, or someone else's...
Can you find your true path in the 10 days allowed? 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE087430.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
主人公遇见了一个审判他命运的神秘女孩……是他的命运，还是某个别人的命运……
在获准的10天内，你能找到真正的道路吗？

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE087430.html]DLSite English[/url]]
